name: Prism Stack
summary: A clean block puzzle where every placement matters. Fit colorful pieces onto the board, complete lines, and build a high score at your own pace.

name: Grandstay Manager
summary: Run a growing hotel, serve guests, improve rooms, and expand your hospitality business in a light management adventure.

name: Chroma Pour
summary: Pour colored liquids between tubes until every color is neatly separated. Plan each move and solve increasingly tricky puzzles.

name: Lexi Link
summary: Swipe through letters to discover hidden words, complete each board, and sharpen your vocabulary with satisfying word puzzles.

name: Rally Rush
tagline: Grow the crowd. Reach the goal.
summary: Guide your runners through gates and obstacles, grow the strongest crowd, and race toward the finish in quick arcade levels.

name: Cubic Matchscape
summary: Search a colorful pile of 3D objects, collect matching trios, and clear every item before the tray fills up.

name: Empire Idle
tagline: Grow a business, one tap at a time.
summary: Build, upgrade, and automate a growing business empire in an easygoing idle management game.

name: Metro Dash
summary: Dash through a lively urban route, avoid obstacles, collect rewards, and keep your run alive for as long as possible.

name: Merge Foundry
summary: Combine matching pieces to create upgraded items, unlock new discoveries, and keep your merge board growing.

name: Velvet Solitaire
summary: Enjoy a polished solitaire experience with familiar rules, clear cards, and relaxing play designed for iPhone.
